answers.rationale: The requirement describes a mechanism for disconnecting and grounding transformer fuses, which is a feature of metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is suitable as it is arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear designed to IEEE C37.20.2, which includes provisions for safe operation and maintenance.

Voltage transformers (VTs) are typically part of metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product supports the inclusion of VTs compliant with ANSI C57.13, as it is designed to meet relevant standards for switchgear.

The requirement specifies current transformers (CTs) with detailed characteristics, which are integral to metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is appropriate as it supports CTs meeting ANSI C37.20.2 and C57.13 standards.
The provision of KWH meter sockets is a feature that can be integrated into metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product can accommodate such configurations as part of its customization.
Test switch assemblies are typically included in metal-clad switchgear for testing and maintenance purposes. The CROWN-ARMV product can be configured to include such assemblies.
Auxiliary relays and interlock contacts are part of the control scheme in metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product supports these features as part of its design.

The detailed control power circuit and auxiliary switch requirements are typical for metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is designed to meet such specifications, including compliance with ANSI C37.11.
Factory-installed internal control wiring is a standard feature of metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product includes this as part of its offering.
The wiring specifications, including wire types and installation practices, are standard for high-quality metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product meets these requirements as part of its design.
